observations.title: Great Sitkin volcano (United States)
observations.description: The Alaska Volcano Observatory (AVO) reported that slow lava effusion continued to feed a thick flow in Great Sitkin?s summit crater during 16-23 September based on webcam and satellite images. Minor earthquakes consistent with the growth of the lava dome and occasional rockfalls were detected by the seismic network. Weather clouds obscured webcam and satellite views during most of the week; though slightly elevated surface temperatures were identified in satellite data during 16-17 September. The Volcano Alert Level remained at Watch (the third level on a four-level scale) and the Aviation Color Code remained at Orange (the third color on a four-color scale). Source: US Geological Survey Alaska Volcano Observatory (AVO)
